name: nextbrain-mods
description: Claude Code mods that cut token cost or show it: handoff, model-router, cache-clock, research-router, savings-proof, token-meter, input-router, effort-optimizer, efficient-browser-use, session-header, mods. Claude Code only; the repo rules in skill/ stay universal.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: At 500k tokens, offers Refresh: writes a handoff of the whole chat and moves it to a new chat. Saves a draft first

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Haiku judges each subagent task and picks fast, balanced or deep with a confidence bar; never changes the main chat's model. Logs every pick

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down until the chat's prompt cache goes cold. Keep warm is opt-in (/keepwarm) and stays off unless you start it

plugins.name: research-router
plugins.description: Keeps web research out of the main chat: Haiku shortens big search results and /research-router returns a short brief with sources

plugins.name: savings-proof
plugins.description: /savings opens a pane with every token the other mods saved, today and in this chat

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: Token Meter pane (context, limits with reset time, active subagents, cost, top tools, savings today) with a Full report button, plus a small floating widget above the prompt for the 5 hour and weekly limits

plugins.name: session-header
plugins.description: A thin sticky row above the prompt showing the current working folder and the chat's first few words

plugins.name: input-router
plugins.description: Trims prompt noise before Claude reads it (blank lines, trailing spaces, long runs of identical pasted lines); code blocks are never touched. No model call

plugins.name: effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Lowers thinking effort to low for trivial prompts (thanks, ok, commit, push); never raises it and never touches hard or long prompts. No model call

plugins.name: efficient-browser-use
plugins.description: Smaller default screenshots, page text, console and network reads for the built-in browser, plus a short read-pages-as-text rule; explicit values are never overridden

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: /mods lists every Nextbrain mod and turns each on or off in every chat: /mods, /mods off <name>, /mods on <name>, /mods on all
